user.title: Control4 Yandex Relay
user.description: Connect to the Yandex Relay driver on the Control4 controller. The pairing code is in the driver's properties in Composer. The Home Assistant URL must be reachable from the controller (use the IP address, not a .local name).

data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL for the controller

bind.title: Stations and rooms
bind.description: Pick the Control4 room each Yandex Station streams its music to.

reauth_confirm.title: New pairing code
reauth_confirm.description: The driver on {host} rejected the pairing code (it was probably re-added). Enter the new code from its properties in Composer.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the driver. Check the IP, the port and that Bridge Status is ONLINE.
error.bad_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This driver is already set up.
abort.no_stations: No Yandex Stations found. Set up AlexxIT YandexStation first.

init.title: Stations and rooms
init.description: Pick the Control4 room each Yandex Station streams its music to.

abort.invalid_auth: Wrong pairing code: reconfigure the integration.

volume_fallback.title: Voice volume for {station} uses the fallback path
volume_fallback.description: Control4 Yandex Relay cannot read Alice's commands from {station} (AlexxIT YandexStation {alexxit}). This usually follows an AlexxIT update or a station without a local connection. "Louder/quieter" may now jump. Check that the station is in local mode, reload AlexxIT, and report the AlexxIT version if it persists.

source_missing.title: {station} does not offer the Control4 player
source_missing.description: AlexxIT YandexStation {alexxit} does not list the Control4 room player as a stream target for {station}, so music is not relayed. Reload AlexxIT; if it persists, check "Streaming music" in the AlexxIT settings.

pairing_rejected.title: The Control4 driver rejected the pairing code
pairing_rejected.description: The Yandex Relay driver on {host} does not accept the code (it was probably re-added). Easiest: paste the previous code {code} into the new driver's "Pairing Code" property in Composer; Home Assistant pairs again within a minute. Or reconfigure the integration with the new code (offered automatically after 10 minutes).

driver_unreachable.title: The Control4 driver cannot be reached
driver_unreachable.description: No answer from the Yandex Relay driver at {host}:{port} for 5 minutes. Check the controller, the driver's "Bridge Status" (ONLINE) and "Bridge Port". If the driver was re-added on another port, reconfigure the integration.
